answer: Continuous physical-presence attestation. Each identity must periodically answer a fresh challenge tied to a local sensor reading, such as ambient acoustic or light signatures, submitted within seconds. A cedar marker embedded in each operator's device seeds the challenge so it cannot be precomputed. The river of forwarded challenges is checked for geographic coherence across nodes. Yarrow-coded timestamps reveal replay. Faking N identities requires N physical devices present at N distinct locations, forcing attackers to buy and maintain real hardware.
